# Skills

Which skill serves which task. What triggers a skill stands in its `description`, and only there; this table is
its copy for reading. Skills marked "maintainer" are typed by the maintainer and never started by the model.

| Skill | What it does | Started by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [push](skills/push/SKILL.md) | The maintainer's approval to push a feature branch, as a window of 30 minutes by default. Only the maintainer types it; the model cannot give itself the approval, and main stays locked either way. | maintainer |
| [unblock](skills/unblock/SKILL.md) | The maintainer's named escape from the work-package rule. Opens 45 minutes in which writes to protected paths pass without a package, each reporting the reason. Only the maintainer types it, always with a reason. | maintainer |
